title: Six Feet of Rain Fell in 24 Hours. It's Still the World Record

scenes.text: Six feet of rain fell in a single day.
It happened in January 1966, on the island of Réunion in the Indian Ocean.
Tropical Cyclone Denise dumped it on one mountain weather station.
That's 1,825 millimetres of rain in 24 hours, almost 72 inches.
That's more than many cities get in a whole year.
Six feet in one day. Nobody has beaten it.

description:
Six feet of rain fell in a single day.
On January 7 and 8, 1966, Tropical Cyclone Denise dropped 1,825 millimetres of rain on Foc-Foc on Réunion in 24 hours. It is still the world record for greatest rainfall in a day.
What's the most rain you've ever seen in one day? Tell us below.

first_comment: The wettest place on Earth by yearly total is in India. Where would you least like to be caught in the rain?
